title: Invoice approval flow: where the 9-day delay lives
caption: Reconstructed from AP system logs, Apr-Jun 2026; n=2,140 invoices, median cycle 11 days.

spec.dsl:
flowchart TD
  subgraph SUP[Supplier]
    A([Invoice received])
  end
  subgraph AP[Accounts Payable]
    B[Log in ERP]
    C{PO match?}
    D[Manual research]
    E[Queue for approval]
  end
  subgraph MGR[Cost-center manager]
    F{Amount > $5k?}
    G[Auto-approve]
    H[Await sign-off]
    I{Approved?}
  end
  subgraph FIN[Finance / payment]
    J[Schedule payment]
    K([Paid])
    L([Rejected])
  end
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C -->|matched| E
  C -->|no match| D
  D --> E
  E --> F
  F -->|under threshold| G
  F -->|over threshold| H
  G --> J
  H --> I
  I -->|yes| J
  I -->|no| L
  J --> K
  H:::bottleneck
  classDef bottleneck fill:#fee2e2,stroke:#dc2626,stroke-width:2px;

semantic_description.level_1_elemental: A four-lane swimlane flowchart (Supplier, Accounts Payable, Cost-center manager, Finance) tracing an invoice from receipt to paid or rejected, with three decision diamonds: PO match, amount over $5k, and manager approval.
semantic_description.level_2_statistical: 12 process nodes and 3 decision points; the longest path traverses all four lanes via manual research and managerial sign-off; one node (Await sign-off) is flagged red as the bottleneck.
semantic_description.level_3_perceptual: Flow runs top-to-bottom; most branches converge on Schedule payment, but the 'over threshold' branch detours into the red Await sign-off node before reaching it, visually isolating where the delay accumulates.
semantic_description.level_4_contextual: The over-$5k manager sign-off step concentrates the cycle-time delay; sub-threshold invoices auto-approve and clear quickly.
semantic_description.short_alt: Four-lane invoice approval flowchart; the over-$5k manager sign-off node is marked red as the delay bottleneck.
